name: Microbiology
description: The topics include introduction to cell structure of prokaryotic and eukaryotic microorganisms; microbial nutrition and growth; metabolism including important pathways; bacterial reproduction and recombination; preservation and control of microbial cultures; molecular tools to study microorganisms (culturables and as-yet-unculturables), viruses; microbial pathogenicity, antimicrobial resistance, and the interaction of microorganisms with other organisms in the context of One Health
